trigger: Fresh primary-source review after the first support implementation exposed that generic addition of per-hop approximation values is not justified unless the declared error semantics has a certified composition rule.
source_projection: Rischel and Weichwald, Compositional Abstraction Error and a Category of Causal Models, arXiv:2103.15758: compositional error can be bounded under a specifically constructed compositional framework, while naive KL-divergence errors can violate the triangle inequality arbitrarily badly.
new_blocking_rule: End-to-end numerical error accumulation is CANNOT_CHECK unless all hops declare the same error semantics and a predeclared composition-rule certificate states that the path upper bound is valid for that semantics. Generic pairwise numbers must never be summed merely because they are called errors.

worlds.description: All hops report numeric approximation values but no error-semantics/composition rule is declared.
One hop reports a TV-style bound and another reports KL divergence under one claimed additive path budget.
All hops call their values KL divergence and the path attempts generic additive composition without a certified rule.
All hops use one declared error semantics with a predeclared certified ADDITIVE_UPPER_BOUND rule and the accumulated value is within tolerance.
The error-composition rule is selected after endpoint outcomes are observed.

acceptance_rule: The corrective support layer must fail closed on missing, mismatched or post-hoc error composition semantics and preserve the original no-authority boundary.
